name: Medication Adherence for Diabetes Medications
certification: Approximation of the PQA proportion-of-days-covered measure used for Part D Star Rating Medication Adherence for Diabetes Medications, not certified: follows the public specification with simplified code sets mapped to the codes Agere receives. Inpatient/SNF stay days are not credited.
steward: Pharmacy Quality Alliance (PQA); CMS Part D Star Ratings
programs: Medicare Part D Star Ratings (D08, triple-weighted)

citations.title: 2027 Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (last updated 09/30/2026; measurement year 2025 data)
2026 Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes (updated 09/25/2025)

denominator.summary: Members 18+ with at least two fills of the class on different dates in the period and a treatment period (first fill to period end) of at least 91 days; enrolled.

exclusions.label: Hospice or palliative care (Z51.5 / hospice encounter)
End-stage renal disease or dialysis (N18.6, Z99.2)

numerator.summary: Proportion of days covered >= 80% from the first fill in the period to period end (days supply from the dispense; overlapping fills shift forward).
